verdicts.reason: A keeps the owls big enough to read as the hero art and gives the headline real prominence. But the 'EVENT MANAGEMENT' eyebrow sits stranded at the far left, away from its headline, and the confetti is crammed into a small cluster in the middle with dead space around it. B groups the text, but it puts the eyebrow under the headline instead of above it and shrinks the owls to tiny smudges. It also pushes the confetti into a separate right-hand block and leaves the left edge empty, so the original's main imagery barely survives.
